Messages.Author: Nick
Messages.Body:
I got two questions, which probably have been answered before but I cannot
find a ruling on the net.

1) Black cat uses concealed weapon to equip magnum, is the cost 1 or 2 pool?
(I noticed the text on black cat says 'equip actions cost 1 less', but
concealed isn't really a action is it?

2) Meshenka with Meat Hook plays body arsenal (or chiropteran Marauder) and
strikes with the hook. Is all the damage dealt with the weapon aggravated?
How about other +strength weapons?

/ Nick

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <bbsr5e$d480n$1...@ID-116157.news.dfncis.de>, Nick

<drspa...@hotmail.com> writes:
>I got two questions, which probably have been answered before but I cannot
>find a ruling on the net.
>
>1) Black cat uses concealed weapon to equip magnum, is the cost 1 or 2 pool?
>(I noticed the text on black cat says 'equip actions cost 1 less', but
>concealed isn't really a action is it?

1 pool.

See the official card text on-line:

"Equipping Black Cat costs 1 less pool (but never less than 0 pool)."

No action requirement.

>2) Meshenka with Meat Hook plays body arsenal (or chiropteran Marauder) and
>strikes with the hook. Is all the damage dealt with the weapon aggravated?
>How about other +strength weapons?

No.

Melee weapons deal melee weapon damage. Body Arsenal affects hand
damage.

Hand damage must come from hand strikes. A hand strike must be at close
range, strength based and not from a weapon. Therefore, Meat Hook is
not a hand strike, so it does not deal hand damage, so Body Arsenal
doesn't affect it.

Messages.Author: reyda

Nick wrote:
|| I got two questions, which probably have been answered before but
|| I cannot find a ruling on the net.
||
|| 1) Black cat uses concealed weapon to equip magnum, is the cost 1
|| or 2 pool? (I noticed the text on black cat says 'equip actions
|| cost 1 less', but concealed isn't really a action is it?

costs one less since, following LSJ's logic, the concealed weapon card
mention the word EQUIP.

|| 2) Meshenka with Meat Hook plays body arsenal (or chiropteran
|| Marauder) and strikes with the hook. Is all the damage dealt with
|| the weapon aggravated? How about other +strength weapons?

No. when you play a card that states "aggravated hand damage" and you strike
with a weapon, you are obviously not striking with your hand. So the damage
is not aggravated. Only a hand ful cards allows you to strike with a weapon
and do agg. damage anyway.
